title: Create src/lib/tasks/reader.ts — read/write tasks.json
description: Create a module for reading and writing tasks.json. Provides functions to read validated tasks, write updated tasks back, filter incomplete tasks, and mark tasks as complete.
acceptanceCriteria: readTasks(agentDir) returns validated Task[] from tasks.json
writeTasks(agentDir, tasks) writes the array back to tasks.json
getIncompleteTasks(tasks) returns only tasks where passes is false
markTaskComplete(tasks, id) returns a new array with the matching task's passes set to true
readTasks throws a descriptive error if tasks.json is missing or invalid

steps.details: Create the file. Import fs-extra, path, and TasksFileSchema from schema.ts. Define the tasks.json path helper: `function tasksPath(agentDir: string): string { return path.join(agentDir, 'tasks.json') }`

Export: async function readTasks(agentDir: string): Promise<Task[]> { const raw = await fs.readJson(tasksPath(agentDir)); const parsed = TasksFileSchema.parse(raw); return parsed.tasks; }. If file not found, throw: new Error('tasks.json not found. Run rocket init to create it.')
Export: async function writeTasks(agentDir: string, tasks: Task[]): Promise<void> { await fs.writeJson(tasksPath(agentDir), { tasks }, { spaces: 2 }); }

Export: function getIncompleteTasks(tasks: Task[]): Task[] { return tasks.filter(t => !t.passes) }. Export: function markTaskComplete(tasks: Task[], id: number): Task[] { return tasks.map(t => t.id === id ? { ...t, passes: true } : t) }

technicalNotes: fs.readJson from fs-extra automatically parses JSON — no need for JSON.parse(await fs.readFile(...))
writeTasks uses { spaces: 2 } for human-readable output
markTaskComplete returns a new array (immutable update) — do not mutate the input
